nodes.description: Cumulative anthracycline exposure injures cardiomyocytes by interfering with topoisomerase II. The parallel iron-dependent oxidative route is modelled as its own node. The cardiac selectivity comes from the isoform. Proliferating tumour cells express topoisomerase II-alpha, which is what makes anthracyclines effective; quiescent cardiomyocytes express topoisomerase II-beta instead, and it is disruption of that isoform that drives cardiac damage. Silencing TOP2B in human iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes reduces doxorubicin-induced apoptosis and preserves mitochondrial and sarcomere structure, which is the evidence that the isoform is causal rather than incidental.

evidence.snippet: Doxorubicin (Dox) is a potent chemotherapeutic agent, but its use is limited by cardiotoxicity, primarily due to the disruption of Topoisomerase-2 beta (TOP2B) activity.

evidence.reference_title: SiRNA-mediated knockdown of TOP2B protects hiPSC-derived cardiomyocytes from doxorubicin-induced toxicity.
evidence.snippet: Our results demonstrate that TOP2B silencing significantly decreases apoptosis and improved cell viability, as compared to the Dex treatment.
The basic mechanisms of cardiotoxicity may involve direct pathways for reactive oxygen species generation and topoisomerase 2 as well as other indirect pathways.

nodes.description: The symptomatic endpoint, which may declare years or decades after treatment.

Exposure is therapeutic and intentional rather than accidental, which is what separates this from the environmental toxicant entries: the dose is known, recorded, and capped precisely because of this toxicity.

evidence.snippet: Anthracycline chemotherapy maintains a prominent role in treating many forms of cancer.

nodes.description: The only agent specifically licensed to reduce anthracycline cardiotoxicity. It is an iron chelator that also interferes with topoisomerase II-beta, and it acts on the initiating injury rather than on established remodelling, which is why it is given alongside the anthracycline rather than after cardiomyopathy appears.

evidence.reference_title: Pharmacological interventions to prevent cardiotoxicity in patients undergoing anthracycline-based chemotherapy: a network meta-analysis.
evidence.snippet: For reducing cardiac events, Dexrazoxane [OR = 0.28, 95% CI (0.16, 0.50)] and Vitamin E combined with Levocarnitine [OR = 0.27, 95% CI (0.08, 0.90)] were the most effective interventions.

evidence.reference_title: Cardioprotection and Second Malignant Neoplasms Associated With Dexrazoxane in Children Receiving Anthracycline Chemotherapy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
evidence.snippet: Several randomized controlled trials (RCTs) have demonstrated that dexrazoxane reduces anthracycline cardiotoxicity in adults, but use in children has been hindered by lack of direct evidence of cardioprotection and concerns regarding second malignant neoplasms (SMNs).

nodes.description: The second direct route. Anthracyclines complex with iron and redox-cycle, generating reactive oxygen species in a cell with limited antioxidant reserve. It is separated from the topoisomerase route because the two are pharmacologically separable: dexrazoxane's iron-chelating action addresses this arm, and its topoisomerase II-beta action addresses the other, so a single bundled node could not represent what the drug does.

nodes.description: Cardiomyocytes are among the most mitochondria-dense cells in the body, so injury registers first as loss of mitochondrial integrity. TOP2B knockdown preserves mitochondrial morphology, which places this node causally downstream of the trigger rather than as a parallel consequence.

nodes.description: Cumulative cardiomyocyte loss reduces left ventricular ejection fraction. The dose-limiting nature of this toxicity is what caps cumulative anthracycline exposure in treatment protocols, and because cardiomyocytes do not meaningfully regenerate, the deficit can declare itself years or decades after treatment ends in patients who were cured of their cancer.

evidence.snippet: Cardiotoxic side effects limit their dosing and improved cancer outcomes expose the cancer survivor to increased cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.

nodes.description: The defining measurable abnormality and the parameter surveillance echocardiography is looking for. Most decline is asymptomatic when first detected, which is why surveillance rather than symptom-watching is the standard of care in survivors.

Disorganisation of the contractile apparatus itself. Kept separate from the mitochondrial node because they are different substrates, and because TOP2B knockdown was shown to preserve them as two distinct structural readouts.

nodes.description: A mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist, given CONCURRENTLY with the anthracycline as prevention rather than as treatment for established dysfunction - the trials in this evidence base all ran alongside chemotherapy. It reported the largest ejection-fraction effect of any agent in a 28-trial network meta-analysis, but that estimate rests on a single contributing trial, against four for carvedilol and two each for enalapril and nebivolol. A large effect from one arm of a network is the situation where network meta-analysis is least reliable, so this entry records the estimate and the caveat together and does not present spironolactone as better supported than the replicated beta-blocker and ACE-inhibitor classes.
